Privacy & browser storage

Cookies and storage

Samajh’s app code sets no tracking or advertising cookies. It uses browser storage for functional settings, drafts and sign-in. Hosting and authentication services process requests to deliver the site and may keep service logs.

  • Profile: your chosen name, language and accessibility preferences stay in this browser.
  • Activity: tool IDs and times are remembered only when you turn that option on. The current tab also remembers recent tool signals for guided practice. File names, links and media are not added to this record.
  • Private drafts: the text you save for yourself stays in this browser. Anyone with access to this browser profile may be able to read it.
  • Sign-in: Supabase receives your email and manages authentication. The Studio keeps the sign-in session in the current browser tab. The separate cloud learning account has its own sign-out control.

Practices and files

Your microphone and screen preview stay on your device. Browser permission is requested before capture. A practice sent for review is stored with your account in Supabase. Reviewers can access submissions and reports. If a practice is approved, the title, goal, steps, success check and optional contributor name become public. Keep personal data out of submissions.

Deleting a local draft leaves any submitted copy in the review system. Contributor sign-in is currently paused for launch setup. A private contact for account and data requests should be listed here before that feature opens.

Reset this browser

Choose what to clear. This affects only Samajh data in this browser. Cloud submissions and account records are separate.
